budget.note: Budgets are declared in provider tokens and converted with a measured ratio.

manifest.citable_note: citable_as_saving / citable_as_quality_equivalence are set false until the independent audit passes all three acceptance conditions; the audit result decides, not this manifest
manifest.failure_policy: preserve sample failure and continue unless provider unavailable or request cap

acceptance.unit_count: per-arm units = 4 tasks x 3 repeats = 12 (NOT r13's 16)
acceptance.condition_1_behaviour: plugin tool_sequence_consistent = 12/12 and per-task not below baseline; first_pass_facts not below baseline
acceptance.condition_2_quality: strict and semantic success not below baseline per task and overall
acceptance.condition_3_cost: same work (equal agent call counts and first-role traces) and paired complete-total tokens positive on the majority and in the batch mean; fewer tool calls or fewer model calls never count as saving
acceptance.verdict_rule: all three required for 'first valid saving candidate'; otherwise 'not_passed_quality_gate' and the host keeps its r13/r14 closure

homogeneity_boundary: the four tasks share the constructed 14-pair filler history, so the narrow per-task upper-bound band is an artefact of one design round; cross-task uniformity is NOT evidence of task-level heterogeneity, and per-task means plus dispersion must be reported with this caveat
protection_cost_definition: pinned characters converted at 2.41 characters per token (measured on the r15 payload) plus whole-prefix fallback tokens and auxiliary summary tokens
self_hash_of: the freeze content with the freeze_sha256 field left empty; a file cannot contain its own digest, so the batch manifest records this value and the auditor recomputes it
revision_discipline: immutable once written; any revision requires a *_FREEZE_AMENDMENT_<date>.json recording what changed, why, and the old and new SHA256
